hook_text: From one lookout, can you spot a mountain, a range, a cape and a bay?
clip_script: Cape Point, high on the cliffs. A mountain, high and steep. A range: a line of peaks running north to Table Mountain. Hills: lower, with gentle slopes. Valleys: low land between them, often with a river. A waterfall, where a river drops over a cliff, like the Tugela Falls. And at the edge of the land: Cape Point, a cape sticking out into the sea, and False Bay, a bay curving into the land.
visual_style: Whiteboard coastal view from a lighthouse with each feature labelling itself: peak, range, valley, waterfall, cape, bay.
mood: Breezy and discovering, like a treasure hunt on a clifftop.
pacing: One feature at a time, ticking them off a list of eight.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find an example of each feature on a map of South Africa.
